knobs.note: Read by bin/merge-queue.sh as ${MC_MAIN_RED_LABEL:-fix-main-red}, and registered only so that read is visible (section 7 of tests/lanes-registry-test.sh). NOT settable here (BH-1985): the label is set in ONE place, the lib row lib.main-red-label.mc_main_red_label (BH-1770), which every reader resolves first. A lane row would split the label for this lane alone, so lane-gate ignores one; MAIN_RED_LABEL is a deprecated alias.

Read by bin/merge-queue.sh as ${MQ_ABSENT_ALERT_AFTER:-3} (BH-784). How many consecutive HTTP 404 reads on ONE queue row before exactly one ALERTS.log line names it. The row is never dequeued on a 404 and the counter clears on any readable tick, so this only decides when a human hears about a row GitHub keeps answering 404 for. 0 means the alert never fires; the counter starts at 1.
